Terms of service

ArchJobs · archjobs.adityapstakuli.com · Last updated 22 November 2026

These terms cover your use of ArchJobs (archjobs.adityapstakuli.com) and its Chrome extension, ARCH in Chrome. ArchJobs is run by Velocity Technologies, Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India (“we”). By creating an account or using ArchJobs you agree to these terms.

What ArchJobs does

ArchJobs collects architecture, interiors and BIM job and internship openings from public sources, job alert emails and firms' careers pages, and helps you track your applications. It also offers AI tools: CVs and cover letters tailored to a job, job suggestions (fit, missing skills, what to fix), reading your CV and portfolio into a profile, and answers for application forms through ARCH in Chrome.

Your account

  • You sign in with Google or with a login ID and password. Keep your sign-in details to yourself. You are responsible for what is done with your account.
  • Give true information in your profile and application details. ArchJobs writes CVs and fills forms from what you provide.
  • You must be at least 16 years old to use ArchJobs.

Free and Pro plans

  • Free: job search, the daily digest, job emails, the application tracker and Gmail reading are free. The AI tools come with a few free uses every week (shown in Settings > Plan), which reset every Monday at midnight India time.
  • ArchJobs Pro removes the weekly limits: ₹199 for 30 days or ₹1,499 for 365 days, prices in Indian rupees including any applicable taxes. Daily fair-use limits still apply to every account so the service stays available to everyone.
  • Pro is a one-time payment for the period you choose. It does not renew automatically and you are never charged again unless you buy again. Buying again while Pro is running adds the new days to the end of your current period.
  • Payments are processed by Razorpay. ArchJobs never sees or stores your card, UPI or bank details.
  • Prices and plan contents may change. A change never affects a period you have already paid for.
  • Refunds are covered in the cancellation and refund policy.

AI output and job listings

  • CVs, cover letters, suggestions and form answers are written by AI models from your own information. They can contain mistakes. Read and correct everything before you send it. You are responsible for what you submit to employers.
  • ARCH in Chrome fills forms for you to check. It never submits an application by itself.
  • Job listings come from third parties. We do not employ, recommend or vouch for any employer, and we cannot promise that a listing is accurate, still open, or that you will get an interview or a job.

Fair use

Do not misuse ArchJobs: no automated scraping of the service, no attempts to get around limits or payments, no sharing of Pro accounts, no uploading of content that is unlawful or not yours to use, and no attempts to break or overload the service. We may suspend or close an account that does this. If we close a paid account for misuse, the unused part of the payment is not refunded.

Your content

Your CV, portfolio, details and tracker remain yours. You allow us to store and process them only to provide ArchJobs to you, as described in the privacy policy. You can delete your files in the app and ask for your account to be deleted at any time.

Availability and liability

ArchJobs is provided as it is. We work to keep it running, but it may sometimes be unavailable, and the free AI models it uses may be busy. To the extent the law allows, our total liability to you for any claim is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim, and we are not liable for indirect losses such as a missed job opportunity.

Ending your use

You can stop using ArchJobs at any time and ask for your account to be deleted. We may stop offering ArchJobs with reasonable notice; if we do, we refund the unused part of any Pro period.

Law and disputes

These terms are governed by the laws of India. Any dispute falls under the courts of Dehradun, Uttarakhand. Please write to us first; most problems can be sorted out quickly.

Changes and contact
